notes: Source PDF is a fully scanned document (no text layer on any of its 60 pages). All evidence_quote values were transcribed by reading rendered page images and cannot be machine-checked against PDF text; verify against the page images.
page_index equals the printed page number for every page used (PDF page N shows '- N -').

Brand 'Clvdrives' is NOT printed in the pages read (cover/TOC, ch.2, ch.5, ch.6, warranty page). It is taken from the folder name and the nameplate photo (WhatsApp Image ... (2).jpeg shows 'Clvdrives' MODEL: V900-0015G1). The manual names the product only as '900 Series AC Drive' / '900 series'. The manual's model table (p.6) lists models as '900-0007G1' etc. without the 'V' prefix; naming rule example 'X900-0075 G 3 EE 0001 *'.

Page 23 legend: '☆' modifiable in stop or run; '★' cannot be modified in running state; '▲' and '*' factory parameter. The U0 monitoring table marks all rows '▲', while section 5.2 says monitoring parameters 'can only be read and cannot be modified'; access set to Read.
F3-17 Reverse Control (p.34): the Minimum/Default/Maximum/Unit/Change Permission cells all print 'Inversion control'; default/range therefore recorded as null.
Conflict p.51: text says F0-00..F9-40 map to 0xF001..0xF928, but the register table shows 0xF000 = F0-00 and 0xF924 = F9-36.

Conflict p.52 vs p.23: section 6.3.2 says set F0-01 = 6 for communication frequency setting, but the F0-01 option list on p.23 gives 6 = 'Constant pressure water supply' and 8 = 'Communication Settings'.
F8-07 range is 0..3 but only options 0, 1, 2 are described.

No maximum-frequency parameter separate from F0-09 'Frequency Upper limit' (described as 'Inverter maximum output frequency'); no base-frequency, motor-poles, comm-protocol selection, response-delay or comm-loss-action parameters found in the pages read. Pages 36, 38, 46 (PLC segments, PID gains, F9-13..F9-25) were not reviewed in detail.
Modbus register 0x02 'Control command' and U0-00 'Inverter Running State' are enumerated values; listed in bit_definitions as 'value N' entries, not bit positions.
